mapper.select: /* AiQuotaMapper.selectQuotaStatus */ SELECT (SELECT Q.MONTHLY_TOKEN_LIMIT FROM TB_AI_TOKEN_QUOTA Q WHERE Q.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}) AS monthlyTokenLimit , (SELECT U.INPUT_TOKENS + U.OUTPUT_TOKENS FROM TB_AI_TOKEN_USAGE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USE_YM = #{useYm}) AS usedTokens
